items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. But when -- when was it that -- well, you must have been -- weren't you working in the same building as Vick Dickinson?

ctx.x: Yeah, and most of them were with Buck and Buddy. Then I went to Europe in '63. Well, I had gone to Europe. And in '69 I took off and went to -- with Jay, and we stayed over there for about a month, and I came on back to the bank, but I still was doing my things out in the -- in Hackensack, you know.
Yeah. But when -- when was it that
-- well, you must have been -- weren't you working in the same building as Vick Dickinson?
